about: revmoves3 (2026-11-21, the move audit's follow-up): AKI Man (0x0379, Revenge import, slot 0, CPU) against The Rock (CPU), singles; his entry 11 -- 'revenge:1355_1357@16362' -- forced wherever the game picks a move of the same place (qa_fsub 4: the one entry).
